children: Staking rewards on Zero are set to begin on 30 Nov 2026. The rewards come from newly minted ZRO, and stakers will receive a share of those tokens for the ZRO they have staked.
The rewards give ZRO holders a reason to keep their tokens staked. Holding ZRO without staking it does not qualify a holder for a share of these rewards.
Zero staking is now open. Rewards begin accruing Nov 30. All stake unlocks March 31, 2027.
The LayerZero Foundation will stake 100M ZRO on the same terms as other stakers. Pre-genesis stake will produce Zero's first blocks at mainnet launch, Nov 30.

title: LayerZero: Staking rewards begin on Zero - 30 Nov 2026
